intro: About 150 kcal for 3 pieces of kuih cara manis. Most of the calories come from the flour batter, santan and the sugar in the centre.
diet: Yes, kuih cara manis is small and easy to control. The problem is it's very easy to keep eating without noticing. Three pieces with teh O kosong still fits your daily budget. But it's low in protein, so it won't keep you full for long.
tips: Put 3 pieces on a small plate, don't eat straight from the container.
Pair with a boiled egg or a glass of milk for extra protein.
Choose teh O or kopi O kurang manis, since the kuih already has sugar.

swap.name: Kuih cara berlauk 2 pieces
swap.why: It has a meat or chicken filling, so more protein and less sugar.

faq.q: What's the difference between cara manis and cara berlauk?
faq.a: Cara manis has sugar in the centre. Cara berlauk has a spiced meat or chicken filling, so it's savoury and has more protein.

faq.q: Can I make kuih cara manis with a regular mould?
faq.a: Yes, use a kuih cara mould or a small bahulu mould. The shape changes a bit, but the taste is the same.

faq.q: How long does kuih cara manis keep?
faq.a: Best eaten the same day. In the fridge it lasts 1-2 days. Warm it up a bit before eating.
